title: Fix a failing test; then a vague follow-up

turns.prompt: There is a small Python package in {D}/slugkit. Run its tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from that directory, fix the bug the failing test points at (do not change the tests), and tell me what was wrong.
turns.verify: cd {D}/slugkit && out=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3); echo "SHOW $out"; sha=$(sha256sum tests/test_slugify.py | cut -d' ' -f1); if echo "$out" | grep -q '^OK' && [ "$sha" = "$(cat ../.test_sha)" ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: $out"; fi

judge.criteria: Answers from the file (names slugkit/__init__.py or the regex), one short paragraph. No tool narration.
A vague ask: one clarifying question with a recommendation (what 'better' should mean), not a silent change and not three questions.
